name: nl.coffeeit.bagtaglibrary.activities.BagtagLibraryActivity
description: CoffeeIT Bagtag opens this Activity to show its airline baggage-tag workflow. It guides the user through account connection, flight details, and communicating with a Bluetooth bag tag to upload its status.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from opening the app Bagtag screen for connection and tag upload.
